rules.name: pz_user_token
rules.description: Login/user name assignments (user=anna.schmidt) in auth log lines.

rules.name: pz_person_line
rules.description: Person name fields (full_name=..., name: ..., praxis_name = Praxis Dr. ...): the rest of the line.

rules.name: pz_text_quoted
rules.description: Quoted free-text fields in JSON and Python dict dumps (note, reason, input, ...).

rules.name: pz_text_assign
rules.description: Quoted free-text assignments (input_value='...' in Pydantic errors).

rules.name: pz_exception_message
rules.description: Message of a Python exception line in native log tracebacks (KeyError: 'Weber'): may quote any input value; the type stays.

rules.name: pz_import_filename
rules.description: Uploaded file name in log lines (XLS-Import fehlgeschlagen (Datei <name>)): often carries an employee name.
